name: Wear them down, against a deep block
engine: Wear them down, with switches and long balls instead of runs, so a deep block that rests still has to shift.
about: The same engine with one tactic swapped for the matchup: a deep block resists runs and rests after every attack without a shot, so Run them ragged gives way to Make them shuttle. Switches and long balls cost their defence 8 stamina (the block has to shift across), and a switch that comes off leaves them stretched for your next decision. Once their defence is under 40 stamina it is fatigued: your clean wins against it need a margin of 3, not 4, and what their defenders learned against Yamal stops counting. From the 55th minute, Torres comes on for Oyarzabal: the fatigue stays with their defence, his fresh legs cost them 10 more, and he is +1 for every 20 stamina they have lost.
decisions: Go round the block, not through it: the switch has worse immediate odds than the run, but the block cannot rest from it.
Keep going at the defender who has learned Yamal's move: he is +2 against it, but each time costs his line 8 stamina, and once his line is fatigued his learning is gone.
Bring Torres on for Oyarzabal once their defence is tired: Oyarzabal's tax stops when your attack drops under 50 stamina anyway, and the fatigue he made stays.
